name: Repository change scout
description: For each repository: clone it (with the worker's GITHUB_TOKEN), have a Pi agent explore it, and say whether the request needs code changes there and where; the repositories are explored in parallel and their findings merged.

repos.description: The repositories to look at: owner/name on GitHub (acme/billing), or an https clone URL.

prompt.description: What should be supported: the change or feature each repository is checked for.

config.command:
# Clones the repository ($REPO: owner/name on GitHub, or an https URL) into
# this step's folder, or brings an earlier clone up to date (a run tried again).
# The PAT is the worker's GITHUB_TOKEN, when it has one: set it in the worker's
# environment and allow it with HYBRID_ADK_WORKFLOWS__TOOL_ENVIRONMENT='["GITHUB_TOKEN"]'.
# Like actions/checkout, it goes in a header for these commands only: never in
# the URL, .git/config or the output, so the Pi agent never sees it.
case "$REPO" in
  https://*) url="$REPO" ;;
  *) url="https://github.com/${REPO%.git}.git" ;;
esac
auth=()
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  basic=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')
  auth=(-c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $basic")
fi
if [ -d .git ]; then
  git "${auth[@]}" fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin
  git reset --quiet --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
  git "${auth[@]}" clone --quiet --depth 1 "$url" .
fi
git log -1 --format='%H %s'

config.instruction: Only read and search: never change a file. Name files by their path from the repository's root.

needs_change.description: Whether this repository's code has to change to support the request.

summary.description: Why, in two or three sentences: what supports it already, or what's missing.

changes.description: Where the code would change: none when it needn't.

file.description: The file's path from the repository's root.

symbol.description: The function, class or section, when there's one.

what.description: What would change there, and why.

config.expression:
{
  "repo": repo,
  "cloned": true,
  "commit": steps.clone.output.stdout,
  "needs_change": previous.answer.needs_change,
  "summary": previous.answer.summary,
  "changes": previous.answer.changes
}

{
  "request": input.prompt,
  "repositories": previous.count,
  "need_changes": [previous.results[needs_change = true].repo],
  "no_changes": [previous.results[needs_change = false].repo],
  "not_cloned": [previous.results[cloned = false]],
  "findings": [previous.results[cloned = true]]
}
